item.question_text: An insurer has an approved and published AI policy, and management reviews it every twelve months. An internal audit finds that the insurer's long-standing data protection and information security policies were written years before any AI deployment, and nobody has examined whether those policies bear on, or are affected by, the insurer's AI-related aims. Which Annex A control best closes this particular gap?

options.text: Working out where the insurer's other policies bear on, or are touched by, its AI-related aims
Documenting a policy that covers how the insurer develops or makes use of AI systems
Reviewing the AI policy at planned intervals and further when circumstances make it necessary
Identifying and documenting the resources needed for activities at AI life cycle stages

item.explanation: The gap is the unexamined intersection between pre-existing corporate policies and the AI objectives, which is exactly the subject of A.2.3, alignment with other organizational policies: the organization "shall determine where other policies can ... be affected by or apply to, the organization’s objectives with respect to AI systems" (A.2.3). The policy itself already exists (A.2.2) and is already on a review cycle (A.2.4), and no resource inventory question arises (A.4.2).
item.key_support: Alignment with other organizaThe organization shall determine where other policies can tional policies be affected by or apply to, the organization’s objectives with respect to AI systems.

distractor_support.support: The organization shall document a policy for the development or use of AI systems.
distractor_support.why_wrong: The insurer already has a documented and approved AI policy, so the deficiency is not the absence of that policy.

distractor_support.support: The AI policy shall be reviewed at planned intervals or additionally as needed to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.
distractor_support.why_wrong: A twelve-month management review cycle already satisfies the planned-interval review control, which says nothing about other corporate policies.

distractor_support.support: The organization shall identify and document relevant resources required for the activities at given AI system life cycle stages and other AI-related activities relevant for the organization.
distractor_support.why_wrong: This control concerns inventorying data, tooling, system and human resources, not reconciling policy documents with AI objectives.
